text: Mother: Keep it open, Ella. It'll protect you from the owl.
note: NAR-04: Ella's mother speaks; P3 (she believes the umbrella keeps her safe)

text: The abyss is endless. The open umbrella's shadow follows her.
note: NAR-05: endless abyss (P4), shadow of the umbrella (P2, P5)

text: The clock has one hand. The other is gone.
The umbrella was once a clock's hand.
note: NAR-06: P2 (her mother made the stolen hand into the umbrella)

text: The owl's pursuit ends. He goes back into the darkness.
note: NAR-07 draft from the team story

text: Ella is alive, but still suspended between worlds.
Perhaps the owl has only postponed his judgment.
